purpose: This table holds hourly weather observations for three New York-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) from January through June 2013, combining time-varying weather measurements (temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, visibility) with static airport reference attributes (name, municipality, elevation, longest runway) and a pipeline capture timestamp.
usage: Read the table at the grain of one row per airport per UTC observation hour (airport_code, observed_hour_utc); filter or join on airport_code to isolate a single airport's time series, and use observed_date_local and observed_hour_local for local-time reporting. Expect wind_gust_mph, pressure_mb, and wind_dir_degrees to be frequently null and handle missing values accordingly.
limitations: The profile cannot confirm that (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) uniquely identifies each row; only a deterministic grain measurement can verify this, since 3 airports times 4341 distinct hours (~13023) does not exactly match the 13014 row_count. wind_gust_mph is missing in roughly 74.5% of rows and pressure_mb in about 11.5%, limiting their reliability for aggregate analysis. captured_at behaves like pipeline or ingestion metadata (only 3 distinct values clustered in 2026, long after the 2013 observation window) despite not being flagged is_airbyte_metadata in the profile; its exact pipeline role should be confirmed by a reviewer. wind_speed_mph's max of 1048.36 mph is implausible for a surface wind reading and may indicate a data quality issue the profile cannot resolve.
